abstract: This paper studies the effect of media market competition on confirmatory bias, the tendency to confirm common priors to appear competent, while accounting for both single‐ and multi‐homing. It finds that competition helps sustain informative reporting when priors are relatively precise, but has the opposite effect when priors are diffuse. The reason is that when competing outlets are perceived as similarly competent, consumers optimally multi‐home. This creates strategic complementarity in informative reporting and helps sustain it when the priors are relatively precise. However, when perceived competencies diverge, consumers single‐home with the outlet they view as most competent, creating incentives for confirmatory reporting when the priors are diffuse.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了媒体市场竞争对确认性偏差（即倾向于确认共同先验以显得专业）的影响，同时考虑了单归属与多归属两种情形。研究发现，当先验信息相对精确时，竞争有助于维持信息性报道；但当先验信息模糊时，竞争则产生相反效果。其原因在于：当竞争性媒体被视为具有相似专业能力时，消费者会最优地选择多归属。这种选择在信息性报道中形成策略互补性，并在先验信息相对精确时有助于维持该报道模式。然而，当感知的专业能力存在差异时，消费者会单归属至其认为最专业的媒体，从而在先验信息模糊时产生确认性报道的激励。
title: Media Market Structure and Confirmatory News
title_zh: 媒体市场结构与确认性新闻

abstract: Researchers have sought to quantify the extent of inequality that is inherited from previous generations or factors that are predetermined at birth in multiple ways, including a large body of work on intergenerational mobility and inequality of opportunity. Many of the most frequently used approaches to measuring mobility or inequality of opportunity fit within a general framework that involves, as a first step, an estimation of the extent to which inherited personal characteristics can predict current incomes. We suggest a new approach, within that broad framework, that is sensitive to differences across the entire conditional distributions of relevant population subgroups, rather than just in their means. Sensitivity to differences in higher moments of the conditional distributions allows for a comprehensive assessment of inherited inequality. We apply this approach to household income distributions in China, India, South Africa and the USA, to illustrate how the method performs in different settings. We find that inherited inequality accounts for large shares of total inequality, from 36% in the USA to 59% in China, 62% in India, and 81% in South Africa.
abstract_zh: 研究者们通过多种方式试图量化代际传承或出生前既定因素所导致的不平等程度，其中包括大量关于代际流动与机会不平等的研究。许多最常用的流动性与机会不平等测量方法均适用于一个通用框架：该框架的第一步是评估先天个人特征对当前收入的预测能力。我们在此框架内提出一种新方法，该方法关注相关人口子群体整个条件分布（而非仅均值）的差异。对条件分布高阶矩差异的敏感性，使我们能够全面评估继承性不平等。我们将该方法应用于中国、印度、南非和美国家庭收入分布数据，以展示该方法在不同情境下的表现。研究发现，继承性不平等占总不平等的比重从美国的36%到中国的59%、印度的62%以及南非的81%不等。

title: Inherited inequality and the distribution of opportunities in the USA, China, India and South Africa
title_zh: 美国、中国、印度和南非的继承不平等与机会分布

abstract: Instrumental variables are a popular tool to infer causal effects under unobserved confounding, but choosing suitable instruments is challenging in practice. We propose gIVBMA, a Bayesian model averaging procedure that addresses this challenge by averaging across different sets of instrumental variables and covariates in a structural equation model. This allows for data‐driven selection of valid and relevant instruments and provides additional robustness against invalid instruments. Our approach extends previous work through a scale‐invariant prior structure and accommodates non‐Gaussian outcomes and treatments, offering greater flexibility than existing methods. The computational strategy uses conditional Bayes factors to update models separately for the outcome and treatments. We prove that this model selection procedure is consistent. In simulation experiments, gIVBMA outperforms current state‐of‐the‐art methods. We demonstrate its usefulness in two empirical applications: the effects of malaria and institutions on income per capita and the returns to schooling. A software implementation of gIVBMA is available in Julia.
abstract_zh: 工具变量是在存在未观测混杂因素时推断因果效应的常用方法，但在实践中选择合适的工具变量颇具挑战性。我们提出gIVBMA方法，这是一种通过结构方程模型中对不同工具变量集和协变量集进行平均化的贝叶斯模型平均程序。该方法能够基于数据驱动选择有效且相关的工具变量，并增强对无效工具变量的稳健性。我们的方法通过尺度不变先验结构扩展了先前研究，并兼容非高斯结果变量和处理变量，比现有方法具有更高灵活性。计算策略采用条件贝叶斯因子分别更新结果方程和处理方程的模型。我们证明该模型选择程序具有一致性。模拟实验表明，gIVBMA优于当前最先进方法。我们在两个实证应用中验证其实用价值：疟疾与制度对人均收入的影响，以及教育回报率。gIVBMA的软件实现已发布于Julia平台。
title: Bayesian Model Averaging in Causal Instrumental Variable Models
title_zh: 因果工具变量模型中的贝叶斯模型平均

abstract: We introduce an overidentification test of two alternative assumptions to identify the average treatment effect on the treated in a two‐period panel data setting: unconfoundedness and common trends. Under unconfoundedness, treatment assignment and post‐treatment outcomes are independent, conditional on control variables and pre‐treatment outcomes, which motivates including the pre‐treatment outcomes in the set of controls. Under common trends, the trend and the treatment assignment are independent, conditional on control variables, motivating a Difference‐in‐Differences (DiD) approach. Given the non‐nested nature of these assumptions and their often ambiguous plausibility in empirical settings, we propose a joint test using a doubly robust statistic that can be combined with machine learning to control for observed confounders in a data‐driven manner. We discuss causal models satisfying either common trends, unconfoundedness, or both assumptions. Applying the proposed method to publicly available datasets, we find that the test rejects the null hypothesis in two out of four cases.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种过度识别检验方法，用于评估两期面板数据中识别处理组平均处理效应的两种替代假设：无混杂性与共同趋势。在无混杂性假设下，处理分配与处理后结果在控制变量和处理前结果条件下相互独立，这促使将处理前结果纳入控制变量集。在共同趋势假设下，趋势与处理分配在控制变量条件下相互独立，这推动了双重差分法的应用。鉴于这两种假设的非嵌套性质及其在实证情境中常存的模糊合理性，我们提出一种联合检验方法，采用双重稳健统计量，可结合机器学习以数据驱动方式控制观测混杂因素。我们讨论了满足共同趋势、无混杂性或两者兼具的因果模型。将所提方法应用于公开数据集后，发现检验在四个案例中有两个拒绝了原假设。
title: A Joint Test of Unconfoundedness and Common Trends
title_zh: 无混淆性与共同趋势的联合检验

abstract: Dealer quotes in corporate bonds, though indicative, lower trading costs and increase trading volume. Dealers offering higher quality quotes attract more order flow and execute trades at favorable prices. Dealers advertise quotes to manage their inventories and attract orders from nonrelationship clients. However, quote competition is imperfect. The best quotes often fail to attract orders, and trade‐throughs are common. Nevertheless, quote competition is important as clients exploit quotes from other dealers in negotiations, forcing dealers with lower quality quotes to offer price improvements. Quoting is not a zero‐sum game, as more active bond‐level quoting leads to more bond‐level trading.
abstract_zh: 公司债券中的交易商报价虽为指示性报价，却能降低交易成本并提升交易量。提供更优质报价的交易商能吸引更多订单流，并以有利价格执行交易。交易商通过报价来管理库存并吸引非关系型客户的订单。然而，报价竞争并不完美。最优报价往往未能吸引订单，且"穿透交易"现象普遍存在。尽管如此，报价竞争仍至关重要——客户会在谈判中利用其他交易商的报价，迫使报价质量较低的交易商提供价格改善。报价并非零和博弈，因为更活跃的债券层面报价会带来更多债券层面交易。
title: Quote Competition in Corporate Bonds
title_zh: 公司债券中的报价竞争

abstract: We show that FX interventions can be effective, particularly in attenuating global financial spillovers. We exploit global financial shocks and Brazilian central bank interventions in FX derivatives using three matched administrative registers: bank credit (to firms), foreign credit to banks, and employer‐employees. After the U.S. Taper Tantrum (followed by emerging markets' FX turbulence), Brazilian banks with more foreign debt cut credit supply, reducing firm‐level employment. A subsequent large policy intervention supplying derivatives against FX risks — hedger of last resort — halved the negative effects. A 2008 to 2015 panel exploiting global FX shocks and local FX interventions confirms the results and the hedging channel. However, the FX policy entails fiscal and moral hazard costs.
abstract_zh: 我们证明外汇干预是有效的，尤其是在缓解全球金融溢出效应方面。我们利用全球金融冲击和巴西央行在外汇衍生品领域的干预措施，结合三组匹配的行政登记数据：银行对企业信贷、银行的外国信贷以及雇主-雇员数据。在美国缩减恐慌（随后引发新兴市场外汇动荡）之后，外债较多的巴西银行削减了信贷供给，导致企业层面的就业减少。随后，一项大规模的政策干预——作为最后对冲者提供外汇衍生品以对冲外汇风险——将负面效应减半。利用2008年至2015年面板数据，结合全球外汇冲击与本地外汇干预的分析，进一步证实了上述结果及对冲渠道的作用。然而，外汇政策也带来了财政成本和道德风险成本。
title: Hedger of Last Resort: Evidence from Brazilian FX Interventions, Local Credit, and Global Financial Cycles
title_zh: 最后避险对冲者：来自巴西外汇干预、本地信贷与全球金融周期的证据

abstract: Through a cluster randomised field trial, we evaluate the impact of an evidence-based, soft skills curriculum aimed at adolescents, referred to as Healthy Minds, that ran in 35 high schools in England over four years (2013/14 – 2017/18). We find supportive evidence that Healthy Minds positively augments the primary outcome of self-reported physical health in the treated adolescents. Treated pupils have global health attainment that is 0.235 standard deviations higher than children in the control group, resulting in a 10-percentile increase in their measured health status. We also find evidence of positive impacts on behaviour. There is no evidence of impacts on improved emotional wellbeing. We note significant gender differences in the effects found, strongly favouring boys. Overall, we provide strong evidence that a designed, taught life skills curriculum can improve related outcomes during the adolescent years, and that differential learning styles across visible aspects of diversity are worthy of consideration Healthy Minds.
abstract_zh: 通过一项整群随机实地试验，我们评估了一项名为“健康心智”的循证软技能课程对青少年的影响。该课程在英国35所高中开展了四年（2013/14至2017/18学年）。研究发现支持性证据表明，“健康心智”课程显著提升了受试青少年自我报告的身体健康这一主要结果。接受干预的学生整体健康水平比对照组儿童高出0.235个标准差，相当于其测量健康状态提升了10个百分点。我们还发现了该课程对行为产生积极影响的证据，但未发现其对情绪健康改善有显著作用。值得注意的是，干预效果存在显著的性别差异，且明显更有利于男生。总体而言，我们提供了有力证据，表明设计并教授的生活技能课程能够改善青少年时期的相关结果，同时，在可见的多样性维度上，差异化的学习风格值得在“健康心智”课程中加以考量。
title: The impact on adolescent health and wellbeing from adding evidence-based soft skill lessons to the high school curriculum
title_zh: 在高中课程中加入循证软技能课程对青少年健康与福祉的影响

abstract: The paper studies the canonical hold-up problem with one-sided investment by the buyer and full bargaining power by the seller. The buyer can covertly choose any distribution of valuations at a cost and privately observes her valuation. I show that, unlike in the well-understood case with linear costs, if investment costs are strictly convex, the buyer’s equilibrium utility is strictly positive and total welfare is strictly higher than when valuations are public information, thus alleviating the severity of the hold-up problem. In fact, when costs are mean-based or display decreasing risk, the equilibrium outcome might be efficient.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了买方单方面投资且卖方拥有完全议价能力的经典敲竹杠问题。买方可以秘密地以一定成本选择任意估值分布，并私下观察其估值。我证明，与线性成本下已充分理解的情形不同，若投资成本严格凸，则买方的均衡效用严格为正，且总福利严格高于估值公开信息时的情形，从而缓解了敲竹杠问题的严重性。实际上，当成本基于均值或表现出递减风险时，均衡结果可能是有效的。
title: The hold-up problem with flexible unobservable investments
title_zh: 灵活不可观测投资下的敲竹杠问题

abstract: This paper offers a simple model to evaluate and measure inequality of opportunity in a multiperiod framework, in which both circumstances and effort may change over time. We adopt a norm‐based approach and an axiomatic methodology: we first characterise two alternative definitions of a ‘fair distribution’, associated respectively with the ex ante and ex post views of equality of opportunity; then we characterise a family of indexes of multiperiod inequality of opportunity expressed as an appropriate distance between the fair and the actual distributions. The proposed framework is then applied to evaluate the Korean distribution of income from a multiperiod and opportunity egalitarian perspective.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Inequality of Opportunity in a Multiperiod Framework
title_zh: 多期框架下的机会不平等

abstract: 中国城乡融合发展正迈向以县域为重要切入点的新阶段。立足县域发展实践，构建系统性分析框架并提炼适用于中国情境的实践模式，是构建城乡融合发展的自主知识体系的必然要求。首先，本文构建“空间-功能-生计”三维分析框架，阐明县域城乡融合发展本质上是城乡空间格局优化、地域功能协同以及居民生计转型相互关联的多维动态过程。在实践中，国土空间治理现代化指引下的城乡空间格局优化是逻辑起点，国家战略叠加下城乡地域功能的...

title: 县域城乡融合发展的理论逻辑与实践模式——基于中国特色实践的一般性分析框架

abstract: Firms can share data to discover potential synergies between their data sets and algorithms, eventually leading to more efficient mergers and acquisitions (M&A) decisions. However, data sharing also modifies the competitive balance when firms do not merge, and a company may be reluctant to share data with potential rivals. Under general conditions, we show that firms benefit from (partially) sharing data. By doing so, they can merge conditionally based on high synergies. Compared to a laissez‐faire situation, the presence of a regulator allowing or refusing the M&A may increase or decrease data sharing, with a concomitant increase or decrease in consumer surplus. Hence, regulation can reduce the surplus of consumers it is willing to protect. We revisit the Google/Fitbit acquisition through the lens of this interplay between strategic data sharing and antitrust policy.
abstract_zh: 企业可以通过共享数据来发现其数据集与算法之间的潜在协同效应，最终促成更高效的并购决策。然而，当企业未进行合并时，数据共享也会改变竞争格局，导致企业可能不愿与潜在竞争对手共享数据。在一般条件下，我们证明企业能从（部分）数据共享中获益。通过这种方式，它们可以基于高协同效应有条件地实施合并。与放任自流的情形相比，允许或拒绝并购的监管机构的存在可能增加或减少数据共享，并随之带来消费者剩余的增加或减少。因此，监管可能反而会降低其本意要保护的消费者剩余。我们通过战略数据共享与反垄断政策之间的这种互动关系，重新审视了谷歌/飞特必收购案。
title: Make or Buy Decisions and Data Sharing
title_zh: 自制或外购决策与数据共享

abstract: When employers face a trade-off between being large and paying low wages—and in this sense have monopsony power—some productive employers decide against building large business networks, forgo sales, and remain small. These decisions have adverse consequences for aggregate labour productivity. Using high-quality administrative data from Germany, we document that East German plants (compared to West German ones) face steeper size-wage curves, invest less in their business networks, remain smaller, and are less productive. A model with labour market monopsony, product market power, and business network investments matching these features of the data predicts a 10% lower aggregate labour productivity in East Germany.
abstract_zh: 当雇主面临规模扩张与低工资之间的权衡——即在此意义上拥有买方垄断势力时，部分高生产率雇主会选择放弃构建庞大的商业网络、牺牲销售额并维持小规模经营。这些决策对总体劳动生产率产生不利影响。基于德国高质量行政数据，我们证实东德工厂（相较于西德工厂）面临更陡峭的规模-工资曲线，商业网络投资更少，企业规模更小，且生产率更低。一个包含劳动力市场买方垄断、产品市场势力及商业网络投资特征（与数据特征相匹配）的模型预测，东德总体劳动生产率将因此降低10%。
title: Monopsony Makes Firms Not Only Small but Also Unproductive: Why East Germany has Not Converged
title_zh: 买方垄断不仅使企业规模变小，还导致其低效率：东德为何未能实现经济趋同

abstract: Incumbents’ reputations acquired during their time in office influence voters’ choices. Some studies suggest that, when designing their campaign messages, incumbents might benefit from playing to their strengths and emphasizing fewer issues than challengers. In this paper, I provide causal empirical evidence to support this hypothesis using information from mayoral elections in Brazil and a regression discontinuity design. The findings indicate that incumbency causes campaign manifestos to be more concentrated. Moreover, incumbents who belong to a cohesive and programmatic party tend to emphasize party-specific issues more. This suggests that reputation matters for issue selection. To measure issue emphasis and manifesto concentration, I leverage a unique database of more than 28 thousand documents containing political manifestos and use a Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm to estimate a vector of topics – or the issues emphasized by each candidate. With this information, I calculate Herfindahl Hirschman Indices (HHI) for each manifesto to assess their relative issue concentration.
abstract_zh: 现任者在任期间积累的声誉会影响选民的选择。一些研究表明，在设计竞选信息时，现任者可能比挑战者更倾向于发挥自身优势，强调较少的议题。本文利用巴西市长选举的信息和断点回归设计，为这一假设提供了因果实证证据。研究结果表明，现任身份导致竞选纲领更加集中。此外，属于团结且纲领性政党的现任者更倾向于强调政党特定议题。这表明声誉对议题选择具有重要影响。为衡量议题强调程度和纲领集中度，我利用了一个包含超过28,000份政治纲领文件的独特数据库，并采用潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）算法来估计每个候选人强调的议题向量。基于这些信息，我为每份纲领计算了赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI），以评估其相对议题集中度。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Play to your strengths: Incumbency effect and issue emphasis in Brazilian local elections
title_zh: 发挥优势：巴西地方选举中的在位效应与议题侧重

abstract: The world is witnessing a surge in green industrial policies, with prominent examples such as the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act incorporating significant protectionist elements. We argue that such green protectionism can play a strategic role in fostering international coordination on climate action. In a simple model combining a standard abatement game with a beggar-thy-neighbor game, we show that protectionist policies improve welfare when expected distortions are low, as they facilitate coordination on climate mitigation at minimal costs. When expected distortions are high, protectionist measures are not adopted and are effectively welfare-neutral. However, when expected distortions are of intermediate size, unregulated protectionist climate policies lead countries to rely excessively on distortive instruments, reducing global welfare. Our findings suggest that regulators like the WTO can enhance welfare by restricting but not entirely banning green protectionist measures. When countries are asymmetric, the case for differentiated regulation depends on whether asymmetries primarily affect countries’ incentives to coordinate on abatement or the social cost of using protectionist instruments to sustain that coordination. We further find that efforts to reduce uncertainty about the size of distortions might backfire, inadvertently encouraging coordination on costly protectionist measures.
abstract_zh: 全球正经历绿色产业政策的激增，其中美国《通胀削减法案》等突出案例包含了显著的贸易保护主义元素。我们认为，此类绿色保护主义在促进国际气候行动协调方面可发挥战略性作用。在一个将标准减排博弈与以邻为壑博弈相结合的简单模型中，我们证明，当预期扭曲程度较低时，保护主义政策能够增进福利，因其以最小成本促进气候减缓方面的协调。当预期扭曲程度较高时，保护主义措施不会被采纳，且实际上对福利无影响。然而，当预期扭曲程度处于中间水平时，不受监管的保护主义气候政策会导致各国过度依赖扭曲性工具，从而降低全球福利。我们的研究结果表明，世界贸易组织等监管机构可通过限制而非完全禁止绿色保护主义措施来增进福利。当各国不对称时，差异化监管的合理性取决于不对称性主要影响各国协调减排的激励，还是影响用以维持该协调的保护主义工具的社会成本。我们进一步发现，减少扭曲规模不确定性的努力可能适得其反，无意中鼓励各国在代价高昂的保护主义措施上达成协调。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Greener thy neighbor? On the welfare effects of protectionist climate policies
title_zh: 更绿色的邻居？论保护主义气候政策的福利效应

abstract: This paper studies the joint roles of inheritance and entrepreneurship in shaping wealth inequality using a heterogeneous agent, general equilibrium overlapping generations model. The analysis is disciplined by new empirical evidence from the Survey of Consumer Finances on how inheritances relate to observed wealth among very wealthy households. In the data, among households in the richest 1% of the wealth distribution, only about 6% have received inheritances that account for at least half of their net worth, and more than half report receiving no inheritance at all. When disciplined by these facts, the calibrated model implies that inheritances play only a limited role in generating extreme wealth, even when accounting for their interaction with entrepreneurship. Using the calibrated model, the paper evaluates estate tax reforms and finds that their effects on wealth concentration are smaller than commonly believed.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含异质性主体、一般均衡重叠世代模型，研究了继承与创业在塑造财富不平等中的联合作用。分析受到消费者金融调查中关于继承与极富裕家庭观测财富关系的新经验证据的约束。数据显示，在财富分布最富有的1%家庭中，仅有约6%的家庭所获继承至少占其净资产的一半，而超过一半的家庭报告未收到任何继承。在这些事实约束下，校准模型表明，即使考虑到继承与创业的相互作用，继承在产生极端财富方面的作用也有限。利用校准模型，本文评估了遗产税改革，发现其对财富集中度的影响小于普遍认知。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 189
title: Inheritance, entrepreneurship, and estate taxation
title_zh: 遗产、创业与遗产税

abstract: When technological substitutes reduce scarcity rents, resource-dependent countries face a timing challenge that traditional resource-curse models do not account for. This paper develops a dynamic political economy model of exit timing and calibrates it to Botswana’s exposure to laboratory-grown diamonds (LGDs). Observable empirical data—including rapid LGD adoption, persistent price declines, and Botswana’s reliance on diamond revenues—informs key parameters and yields policy-relevant insights. Recent market changes underscore this mechanism: Botswana’s diamond inventories reached 12 million carats in 2025, nearly twice the historical levels, while mineral revenues declined by about 60 percent compared to previous averages. The model demonstrates that, with irreversible substitution and varying adjustment speeds, common rent-defense strategies such as cartel coordination, inventory management, and vertical integration are less effective than earlier contraction and faster diversification. Calibration suggests a transition period of roughly 12–15 years; delaying adjustment by five years can reduce the present value of resource wealth by approximately 20–30 percent. The analysis uncovers a distinct form of the resource curse: failing to complete structural transformation before technological substitution renders resource rents obsolete.
abstract_zh: 当技术替代品减少资源稀缺租金时，资源依赖型国家面临着一个传统资源诅咒模型未能解释的时机挑战。本文构建了一个关于退出时机的动态政治经济学模型，并将其校准至博茨瓦纳对实验室培育钻石（LGDs）的暴露程度。可观测的经验数据——包括LGD的快速普及、持续的价格下跌以及博茨瓦纳对钻石收入的依赖——为关键参数提供了信息，并产生了具有政策相关性的洞见。近期市场变化凸显了这一机制：2025年，博茨瓦纳的钻石库存达到1200万克拉，几乎是历史水平的两倍，而矿产收入较以往平均水平下降了约60%。模型表明，在不可逆替代和不同调整速度的情况下，卡特尔协调、库存管理和纵向一体化等常见的租金防御策略，其效果不如更早收缩和更快多元化。校准结果显示，转型期约为12至15年；延迟调整五年可能使资源财富的现值减少约20%至30%。分析揭示了一种独特的资源诅咒形式：在技术替代使资源租金过时之前未能完成结构转型。
title: Diamonds aren’t forever: manufactured substitutes, irreversible substitution, and the new resource curse
title_zh: 钻石并非永恒：人造替代品、不可逆替代与新资源诅咒

abstract: We document a global reallocation of pollutive assets as a response to investor pressure: large firms facing increased investor pressure divest foreign-located pollutive assets to firms that are less in the limelight. There is no evidence of increased engagement in any other emission reduction activities. We estimate that 369 million metric tons (mt) of CO2e are reallocated via divestments in the post-Paris Agreement period. Our results indicate that investor pressure to decarbonize reshapes the global conglomerate structure of large firms.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了投资者压力引发的全球污染性资产重新配置：面临更大投资者压力的大型企业，将位于国外的污染性资产剥离给那些较少受到关注的企业。没有证据表明这些企业增加了其他任何减排活动的参与。我们估计，在《巴黎协定》签署后的时期内，通过资产剥离重新配置了3.69亿公吨二氧化碳当量。我们的结果表明，投资者要求脱碳的压力重塑了大型企业的全球集团结构。
title: Out of sight, out of mind: Divestments and the global reallocation of pollutive assets
title_zh: 眼不见，心不烦：撤资与污染性资产的全球重新配置

abstract: We study whether access to local pollution information causes investors to make greener portfolio allocations, exploiting the rollout of air quality monitoring stations in India. Using a triple-differences framework on the trading records of 19 million investors, we show that retail investors’ holdings in “brown” stocks become more negatively related to local pollution after a nearby station appears. This effect is more pronounced on “alert” dates when air quality is reported to be harmful. The effect is strongest among tech-savvy investors likely “treated” by real-time pollution data, and younger investors, who may be more sensitive to environmental concerns.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了获取本地污染信息是否促使投资者做出更环保的投资组合配置，利用印度空气质量监测站的推广作为自然实验。基于1900万投资者的交易记录，采用三重差分框架，我们发现，在附近监测站设立后，零售投资者对“棕色”股票的持有与本地污染之间的负相关性增强。这一效应在报告空气质量为有害的“警报”日期更为显著。在可能受实时污染数据“影响”的技术娴熟投资者及可能对环境问题更为敏感的年轻投资者中，该效应最为突出。
title: Dirty air and green investments: The impact of pollution information on portfolio allocations
title_zh: 污浊空气与绿色投资：污染信息对资产配置的影响

abstract: Does political polarisation influence actual economic behaviours? Using British nationally representative surveys and administrative data, we document how the Brexit referendum triggered stark divergences in individual micro and macro expectations between Leave and Remain supporters. Compared to existing research, we show how these polarising effects were driven by a specific policy issue and mostly unrelated to traditional partisan identities. We also demonstrate howthese diverging beliefs influenced major real financial decisions. Leavers became more likely to purchase durable goods and engage in housing transactions, and areas with higher proportions of Leave voters experienced increased housing transaction volumes and rising prices.
abstract_zh: 政治极化是否会影响实际经济行为？利用英国全国代表性调查与行政数据，我们记录了脱欧公投如何引发脱欧派与留欧派在个人微观及宏观预期上的显著分歧。与现有研究相比，我们揭示了这些极化效应是由特定政策议题驱动，且与传统党派身份关联不大。我们还证明了这些分歧信念如何影响重大实际财务决策。脱欧派更倾向于购买耐用消费品并参与住房交易，而脱欧选民比例较高的地区则经历了住房交易量增加和价格上涨。
title: Ballots, budgets and bricks: Brexit and the polarisation of individual economic behaviours
title_zh: 选票、预算与砖块：英国脱欧与个体经济行为的极化

abstract: A Hard Problem is a collective choice problem in which the only feasible alternatives to the status quo consist of a welfare gain to some people (the Winners) and a welfare loss to others (the Losers). These problems are typical in a number of settings, such as climate action, anti-trust regulation, and tax design. We study how to make collective choices when faced with Hard Problems. We find that a relatively weak fairness requirement, which we call Expansion Solidarity, necessarily leads to a dictatorship of the Losers, no matter how small their number. Even one single Loser must be given the power to veto any departure from the status quo, regardless of the number of Winners, how large the gains, how small the loss, or how extreme the welfare inequalities.
abstract_zh: 硬问题”是一种集体选择问题，其中唯一可行的替代现状方案包括对某些人（赢家）的福利增益和对其他人（输家）的福利损失。这类问题在多种情境中普遍存在，如气候行动、反垄断监管和税收设计。我们研究在面对硬问题时如何做出集体选择。我们发现，一个相对较弱的公平性要求，我们称之为“扩展团结”，必然导致输家的独裁，无论其数量多么微小。即便只有一个输家，也必须被赋予否决任何偏离现状的权力，不论赢家数量多少、增益多大、损失多小，或福利不平等程度多么极端。
title: The Hard Problem and the Tyranny of the Losers
title_zh: 硬问题与失败者的暴政

abstract: We estimate price elasticities of housing supply for U.S. cities by examining the impact of foreign purchases on housing prices and quantities. After other countries introduced foreign-buyer taxes beginning in 2011, both house prices and quantities increased more in locations with high foreign-born populations. A 1% increase in global capital inflows, instrumented with tax policy changes scaled by immigrant exposure, increased prices and quantities by 3% and 0.5%, respectively, over 2011–2018. We combine these estimates to construct new local supply elasticities. Compared to prior estimates, our elasticities are more inelastic and change cities’ relative rankings.
abstract_zh: 我们通过考察外国购房对美国城市房价和房屋数量的影响，估算了住房供给的价格弹性。自2011年起，其他国家陆续开征外国买家税后，在外来人口比例较高的地区，房价和房屋数量均出现更大幅度的增长。以移民暴露度衡量的税收政策变化作为工具变量，全球资本流入每增加1%，在2011-2018年间房价和房屋数量分别上升3%和0.5%。我们结合这些估算结果构建了新的地方供给弹性。与以往估算相比，我们的弹性系数更缺乏弹性，并改变了各城市的相对排名。
title: Global Capital and Local Assets: House Prices, Quantities, and Elasticities*
title_zh: 全球资本与本地资产：房价、数量与弹性*

abstract: Cooperative game theory has proposed different notions of powerful players. For example, big-boss games (Muto et al. 1988 On Big Boss Games. In: The economic studies quarterly 39.4:303–321")) and clan games (Potters et al. 1989 Clan Games. In: Games and Economic Behavior 1.3:275–293")) are particular cases of veto games (Bahel 2016 On the Core and Bargaining Set of a Veto Game. In: International Journal of Game Theory 45.3:543–566")). The present paper extends these veto games by assuming that there is a given subset of powerful (or essential) players, but only a few (as opposed to all) essential players are required for a coalition to have a positive group value. The resulting games, which are called r -essential games, encompass convex games (Shapley 1971 Cores of Convex Games. In: International Journal of Game Theory 1.1:11–26")) and veto games. We show that r -essential games have a nonempty core. We give a recursive description of the core. Moreover, it is shown that the core and the bargaining set are equivalent for r -essential games. An application to networks is provided. Similar content being viewed by others
abstract_zh: 合作博弈理论提出了多种关于强有力参与者的概念。例如，大老板博弈（Muto等，1988，《论大老板博弈》，载于《经济研究季刊》第39卷第4期，第303-321页）和宗族博弈（Potters等，1989，《宗族博弈》，载于《博弈与经济行为》第1卷第3期，第275-293页）是否决博弈（Bahel，2016，《否决博弈的核心与谈判集》，载于《国际博弈论杂志》第45卷第3期，第543-566页）的特例。本文通过假设存在一个给定的强有力（或关键）参与者子集，但仅需少数（而非全部）关键参与者即可使联盟具有正群体价值，从而扩展了这些否决博弈。由此产生的博弈被称为r-关键博弈，它涵盖了凸博弈（Shapley，1971，《凸博弈的核心》，载于《国际博弈论杂志》第1卷第1期，第11-26页）和否决博弈。我们证明r-关键博弈具有非空核心，并给出了核心的递归描述。此外，研究表明对于r-关键博弈，核心与谈判集是等价的。本文还提供了在网络中的应用。
title: Essentiality of degree
title_zh: 学位必要性的本质

abstract: Processes of bargaining are studied in which the players reach interim agreements that serve as status quo points for further bargaining. This is modeled in Nash’s setup of bargaining problems, where the solution is a time parameterized path of interim agreements rather than a single point. We characterize path solutions for linear problems that satisfy the axioms of restarting and covariance , and show that if a Pareto efficient agreement is not reached immediately, then it is never reached in finite time. Adding the axioms of individual rationality , relevance , and monotonicity , we characterize the family of continuous Raiffa solutions and show that these solutions converge to a Pareto efficient agreement but never reach it in finite time. Finally, if a deadline is added to the bargaining problem, and the speed of bargaining is proportionally inverse to the deadline, then a Pareto efficient agreement is reached exactly at the deadline.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了谈判过程中各方达成临时协议的过程，这些临时协议作为进一步谈判的现状点。该过程在纳什谈判问题框架下建模，其解是一条以时间为参数的临时协议路径，而非单一协议点。我们刻画了满足重启公理和协方差公理的线性问题的路径解，并证明若帕累托有效协议未立即达成，则有限时间内永远无法达成。通过引入个体理性、相关性和单调性公理，我们刻画了连续Raiffa解族，并证明这些解收敛于帕累托有效协议，但有限时间内无法达成。最后，若在谈判问题中加入截止期限，且谈判速度与截止期限成反比，则帕累托有效协议恰好在截止期限时达成。
title: Interim agreements
title_zh: 临时协议

abstract: Dilmé (Internat J Game Theory 53:673 2024) shows that an assessment is Kreps-Wilson (1982) consistent if and only if it is the limit of a particularly simple kind of sequence of strictly mixed strategies—which Dilmé calls a “power sequence”—and its associated sequence of Bayes-rule induced beliefs. We use Farkas’ lemma to provide a brief and simple proof of Dilmé’s result.
abstract_zh: 迪尔梅（《国际博弈论杂志》第53卷，第673页，2024年）证明，一个评估是克雷普斯-威尔逊（1982）一致的，当且仅当它是某种特别简单的严格混合策略序列——迪尔梅称之为“幂序列”——及其关联的贝叶斯规则诱导信念序列的极限。我们利用法卡斯引理，为迪尔梅的这一结果提供了一个简洁而简单的证明。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: A simple proof of the sufficiency of Dilmé’s power-sequence test for Kreps-Wilson consistency
title_zh: 迪尔梅幂序列检验对克雷普斯-威尔逊一致性充分性的一个简单证明

abstract: We conducted an online Dictator Game experiment ( N = 1195) to test three hypotheses about the role of monetary incentives in prosocial behavior. First, we examined whether real incentives of £1 reduce the dispersion of responses compared to hypothetical ones. Surprisingly, we found the opposite: hypothetical responses were less dispersed, with choices clustering around the egalitarian split. This pattern held in a replication ( N = 308) with higher stakes (£5), offering no support for the first hypothesis. Second, we tested whether real incentives—by involving actual monetary consequences—lead to more selfish decisions, as they are expected to reduce socially desirable responses. With £1 stakes, no significant differences emerged across conditions. However, when the stake was increased to £5, participants became more selfish under real incentives, supporting the second hypothesis only when the amount at stake is substantial. Third, we explored whether probabilistic payments trigger differential behavior. At low stakes, probabilistic incentives resembled real ones. But with higher stakes, real and probabilistic outcomes diverged, suggesting participants respond to expected value only when it is meaningful. Finally, in a separate study ( N = 299), we found that many participants facing standard hypothetical-payment instructions still expected real payments. Only explicit phrasing stating that “unfortunately, the money is not real” alleviated this confusion. This result underscores the importance of precise wording in experimental design and potentially explains why hypothetical treatments do not yield dramatically different results compared to real-money treatments.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项在线独裁者博弈实验（样本量N=1195），以检验关于货币激励在亲社会行为中作用的三个假设。首先，我们考察了与假设性激励相比，1英镑的真实激励是否会降低反应离散度。令人意外的是，我们发现了相反的结果：假设性情境下的反应离散度更低，选择集中在平等主义分配方案附近。这一模式在更高赌注（5英镑）的重复实验（样本量N=308）中得以保持，因此第一个假设未获支持。其次，我们检验了真实激励——通过涉及实际货币后果——是否会导致更自私的决策，因为预期这会减少社会期望性反应。在1英镑赌注下，各条件之间未出现显著差异。然而，当赌注增至5英镑时，参与者在真实激励下变得更加自私，这仅在赌注金额较大时支持了第二个假设。第三，我们探讨了概率性支付是否会引发差异化行为。在低赌注下，概率性激励与真实激励相似。但在高赌注下，真实与概率性结果出现分化，表明参与者仅在有意义的预期价值下才会做出反应。最后，在另一项独立研究（样本量N=299）中，我们发现许多面对标准假设性支付说明的参与者仍预期会获得真实支付。只有明确表述“遗憾的是，这笔钱并非真实”才能缓解这种混淆。这一结果凸显了实验设计中措辞精确的重要性，并可能解释为何假设性处理与真实货币处理相比不会产生显著不同的结果。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Paying £1(£5) or nothing in dictator games: unexpected differences
title_zh: 独裁者游戏中支付1英镑（5英镑）与零支付的意外差异

abstract: We study the dynamic interplay between monetary policy and market power in a decentralized monetary economy. Building on Choi and Rocheteau (2024), our key innovation is to model rent seeking as a process that takes time, allowing market power to evolve gradually. Our model predicts that a gradual reduction in the nominal interest rate causes a simultaneous increase in rent-seeking effort and producers’ market power, consistent with the stylized correlation observed in the US over the last few decades. Free producer entry can however reverse this relation in the short run, and neutralize it in the long run. Indeterminacy and hysteresis emerge when consumers benefit from valuable outside options, with short-run monetary policy shocks potentially locking the economy into high- or low-market-power equilibria in the long run. These dynamics are robust to alternative environments, including dividend-paying real assets, access to banking, and a customer-capital interpretation of rent-seeking, highlighting monetary policy’s persistent and state-dependent effects on market structure through endogenous rent formation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个分散化货币经济中货币政策与市场势力之间的动态相互作用。基于Choi和Rocheteau（2024）的研究，我们的关键创新在于将寻租行为建模为一个需要时间的过程，从而使市场势力能够逐步演变。我们的模型预测，名义利率的逐步降低会导致寻租努力和生产者市场势力同时增加，这与美国过去几十年来观察到的典型相关性一致。然而，自由生产者进入在短期内可能逆转这一关系，并在长期内使其中性化。当消费者受益于有价值的外部选择时，会出现不确定性和滞后现象，短期货币政策冲击可能将经济锁定在长期的高或低市场势力均衡中。这些动态在替代环境下依然稳健，包括支付股息的实际资产、银行服务的获取以及寻租的客户资本解释，突显了货币政策通过内生租金形成对市场结构产生的持久且状态依赖的影响。
title: Dynamics of market power in monetary economies
title_zh: 货币经济中市场势力的动态变化

abstract: Conventional wisdom suggests that information transparency about prices lowers prices and markups by intensifying seller competition. We show that, when buyer entry is endogenous, this relationship depends on the price measure under consideration. Information transparency may attract additional buyers and intensify demand-side competition, which can raise the price and the markup charged by sellers that compete for informed buyers. Yet, average posted and traded prices may fall because more sellers compete for informed buyers. Thus, information transparency can lower aggregate price indices while raising individual equilibrium prices and markups.
abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，价格信息透明通过加剧卖方竞争会降低价格和加成率。我们证明，当买方进入是内生的时候，这种关系取决于所考虑的价格度量。信息透明可能吸引更多买方并加剧需求侧竞争，这可能会提高争夺知情买方的卖方所收取的价格和加成率。然而，由于更多卖方争夺知情买方，平均标价和成交价可能下降。因此，信息透明可以降低总体价格指数，同时提高个体均衡价格和加成率。
title: Information, prices and buyer entry
title_zh: 信息、价格与买方进入
